_comment: Integrity lockfile for bare-kit prebuilds fetched by scripts/fetch-prebuilds.mjs (issue #55). `version` MUST match the pinned version in fetch-prebuilds.mjs (and the package bump). `artifacts` maps each downloaded release asset name to its expected SHA-256. The script fails closed on a checksum mismatch. When bumping the bare-kit version, delete and re-fetch the artifact, recompute its SHA-256, and update both `version` and the per-artifact hash here. Do NOT commit placeholder/TODO hashes into a release. `spm` pins the BareKit.xcframework.zip that the root Package.swift `.binaryTarget` resolves (zip of prebuilds/ios/BareKit.xcframework from this bare-kit version, hosted as a GitHub release asset). It changes only when bare-kit is bumped, never per ekrooh release; security.test.ts keeps Package.swift in sync with it.
